meta.classificationMethod: Keep each root family intact; balance rooted cards across five parts; use S words to equalize totals; interleave S words only between root families.

rootGroups.root: acerb, acid, acri, acu 尖、酸
ag, ig: to act 做、動
articul, artic: speak distinctly 清楚地說
auc, aug, aut, aux 增加
blis: happiness, grace 幸福、恩典
fec, fic, fict: to do 做
gru 一致 (glue 黏在一起)
locu, log, logu, loqu 說、言
melior: better, to improve 變好
passi, pati, path 感情、受苦、疾病
phan, phen, phem 出現、顯現
pugn, pugil: fight 打架、爭吵
rac, rad, ras, raz 刮、擦
scan, scend, scent: climb 攀、爬
str (strain, string, strict, stress) 繩子、綑綁、束縛
tach, tact, tag, tig, ting, tamin, tang 接觸
tain, ten, tin 保持、維持、抓住
tric, trick: perplexities 複雜、迷惑
vad, vas: to go, to walk 走
vil, guile 卑鄙的、邪惡的
